citations.claim: total energy at step 31 exceeds limit 2684, actual 14653

counterfactual.change: Changed bodies[1].e from 0.6448 to 0 only. Removes elastic kick in simultaneous collision, energy stays bounded.

explanation: Energy explosion at step 31 when fast light body (initial 58 m/s) hits heavy body (m 19.3kg, e=0) resting on floor. Heavy body jumps from ~7.5 m/s to ~38.4 m/s while light body still ~22 m/s, injecting ~12kJ. Likely cause: simultaneous inelastic floor contact + elastic body-body with large mass ratio and high dt (0.0245s) leads to compounding positional correction / restitution impulses creating non-physical kinetic energy.
vision_note: A small blue body falls from above onto a larger blue body that is hovering just above the floor. From steps 28 to 31 the gap closes until the two are in direct contact at the floor level, which is the moment of the reported simultaneous inelastic floor and elastic body-body collision.
